findings.evidence: 지난주에/어제 부산에 갔어요 are both natural.
작년에/어제 한국에 왔어요 are both natural.

The QA answer lists 왔어요 as a contracted past form, but the reading contains 올 때 and 오자마자, not 왔어요.
findings.fix: Applied answer correction to the forms actually present: 만났어요, 갔고, 봤어요.
